name: InfeKt-FM1
author: J0KERPACK
tagline: A virtual analog synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1
description: InfeKt-FM1 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a virtual analog synthesizer: three oscillators per voice with sub, noise and ring modulator, two multimode filters with analog modes and saturation, three LFOs, a six-slot modulation matrix, up to 16 voices with unison and two parts as layer or split. Distortion, chorus, phaser, EQ, delay, reverb and a shimmer; an arpeggiator, a sequencer played from the keys, an 11-instrument drum machine; MIDI over USB, Bluetooth and the TRS jack; a web editor and patch manager.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0), by Charles Vestal and Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
